blocks.text: Womens walking shoes are made of breathable flying woven fabric, cushion memory foam insole, lightweight eva non-slip outsole, which can perfectly fit your feet and let each step of your move relax. These womens sneakers are suitable for many occasions, such as walking, shopping, cycling, walking the dog, yoga, traveling. These shoes for women are suitable for women, seniors, youth, students, workers, walkers, tourist, hikers, commuters.

items.label: COMFORTABLE
items.value: Cushion memory foam insole of womens sneakers is very comfortable, which makes you feel like you're walking on clouds. You will not feel tired even for long day standing and walking.

items.label: BREATHABLE
items.value: The upper is made of knit fabric with ventilation holes, providing a good fit and breathability, adapting to foot movements and keeping your feet dry all day.

items.label: ANTI-SLIP
items.value: The sole of womens shoes is made of non-slip EVA material, which has good traction and wear resistance, so you can walk freely.

items.label: LIGHTWEIGHT
items.value: The highly elastic and densely woven make womens tennis shoes perfectly fit your feet. Lightweight outsole lets each step of your move relax.

items.label: OCCASIONS
